messages:
Maya K: Hey team — prepping the handoff for the new eu-north bare-metal GPU cluster. Wanted to drop the on-call/ paging + escalation checklist here and get a quick sanity check before we mark the runbook as handed off.

Oliver H: thanks — can you confirm which PD service this maps to and the primary escalation path?

Maya K: PD service: redwood-eun-baremetal-infra (service id in vault: secret/ops/pd/eun-baremetal). Primary escalation: oncall-sre -> eng-infra owner -> eng-shift lead. If PD routing fails it falls back to the eng-platform rotation.

Harpreet S: note — we added a dedicated Alertmanager route for `eun-baremetal` with a higher severity threshold for GPU OOMs. Alert rules + minimum labels attached.

Maya K: exact alert names to watch: `GPU_Utilization_High`, `GPU_Memory_OOM`, `Node_NotReady_long` — sample Prom rule: ```alert: GPU_Memory_OOM
expr: sum by (instance) (rate(nvidia_gpu_memory_errors_total[5m])) > 0
for: 2m
labels:
  severity: page
annotations:
  summary: "GPU OOMs detected on {{ $labels.instance }}"
  runbook: "https://redwood.internal/runbooks/eun-baremetal/ooms"
```

June (oncall): where is the runbook stored? I want the quick steps for triage (commands, who to call).

Maya K: runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/eun-baremetal/handbook  — quick triage bullets in the runbook header: 
- Check Prometheus alert details + Grafana dashboard `infra/eun-baremetal/gpus`
- SSH to bastion: `ssh -A june@bastion-eun` then `kubectl --context=cluster-eun-prod get nodes -o wide`
- Check driver + dmesg: `kubectl debug -n kube-system node/<node> --image=busybox -- dmesg | tail -n 200`
- If OOMs, cordon node + migrate pods: `kubectl cordon <node> && kubectl drain <node> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`

DevInfra: added a dedicated PagerDuty escalation step that pages infra on-call after 2 minutes if severity = page. Also pushing a small OTEL tag so traces include `cluster=eun-baremetal`.

Harpreet S: cost-control note — this cluster has burst capacity turned on; autoscaler will spin new bare-metal nodes only up to the committed pool. We log scale events to `cost/allocations/eun`. If you see an unexpected spike, follow the billing-check list in the runbook.

Oliver H: who holds ownership for networking (BGP + cross-region peering)? We need a contact for routing flaps during cutover.

Maya K: ownership: Network: @Harpreet S (primary), backup: @Oliver H. BGP community tags documented in the runbook. For peering issues page `netops` PD service (link in runbook).

June (oncall): training request — can we get a 20m live walkthrough for the on-call rotation? Preferably a recorded session I can share with new hires.

Maya K: yep — schedule 20m demo: I'll record the triage flow, Harpreet will cover networking edge cases, Oliver will go over cost checks. Plan: Fri 09:30 UTC, calendar invite coming.

sre-bot: Deploy check: new prometheus rules applied to `eun` namespace at 1768800050 by DevInfra. No conflicts detected.

June (oncall): acknowledged. I'll be the primary for the first week while we ramp. Leaving a note: if a page hits between 23:00-03:00 UTC escalate immediately to eng-platform lead (night fallback).

Maya K: perfect — adding that escalation to the PD escalation policy and to the runbook. Marking this thread as the official handoff note. :white_check_mark:

Oliver H: acked. small follow-up: can we add a one-paragraph recovery SLA to the runbook (what counts as mitigation vs full restore)? helps clarify when to engage on-call vs SRE pager.

Maya K: good call — will add SLA bullets (mitigation within 30m, full restore ETA depends on incident class) and ping when done.

Harpreet S: also adding a short cheat-sheet for common network flaps (`show ip bgp summary`, `ip route` checks, `tc qdisc` checks) into runbook and attaching commands.

Maya K: thanks all — final action items: (1) Maya adds SLA and PD policy update, (2) DevInfra confirms PD secret path + OTEL tag pushed, (3) Harpreet adds network cheat-sheet, (4) Oliver drafts cost spike checklist, (5) June runs the on-call demo and records it. Will follow up once all done.

June (oncall): sounds good — I'll close the loop after the recording and add a pointer on the on-call playbook.

sre-bot: Thread archived to `runbooks/handovers` after confirmation.
